label: Apple Ads (formerly Apple Search Ads)
terms_note: Campaign Management API requires an Apple Ads Advanced account with API certificate authentication

discovery.auth: oauth2 client credentials with an ES256 client secret JWT (public key uploaded to the Apple Ads account; X-AP-Context: orgId header)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes**. Two generations: the **Apple Ads Campaign Management API v5** (`api.searchads.apple.com/api/v5`)
auth: 1. Account administrator: Apple Ads → Sign In → **Advanced** → Account Settings → User Management → **Invite Users**, choosing an **API user role**.

2. The API user generates a key pair: `openssl ecparam -genkey -name prime256v1 -noout -out private-key.pem`, extracts the public key (`openssl ec -in private-key.pem -pubout -out public-key.pem`) and uploads it in the account (Users → API).

3. Create a **client secret**: a JWT signed with the private key (ES256), then request an access token (OAuth 2 client credentials). "OAuth 2 replaces key and certificate credentials authentication in previous versions of the API."
4. Every call: `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}` and `X-AP-Context: orgId={orgId}` (not needed on the user-ACL / me endpoints).
5. Errors: 401 token invalid or expired; 403 higher privileges required than the token provides.

reference.limits: - "Rate limits exist in the Apple Ads Campaign Management API"; Apple prescribes exponential back-off (2 → 4 → 8 → 16 s cap) on failures; no numeric quota published on the pages read. - Access: Apple Ads Advanced account (not Basic); free API. Terms: Apple Ads Terms of Service + Apple Developer terms. - Sunset: Campaign Management API on **2027-01-26** — build against the Apple Ads Platform API.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Apple Ads API clientId (SEARCHADS.…) shown after uploading your public key under Account Settings > API (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/apple-ads-platform-api/implementing-oauth-for-the-apple-ads-platform-api).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The client secret JWT you sign yourself with your ES256 private key (header kid=keyId; claims sub=clientId, iss=teamId, aud=https://appleid.apple.com, exp at most 180 days after iat). The runtime does not sign it: regenerate and replace it before it expires.

config_fields.name: ap_context
config_fields.help: The full X-AP-Context header value for ad-account-scoped calls, exactly `adAccountId=<ad account id>` (ids from GET /v1/acls, i.e. list_accounts).

me.note: GET /v1/me: {result: {userId, orgId}} of the API user.

list_accounts.note: GET /v1/acls: ad accounts the token can manage with the user's roles (raw.roles). Put the chosen id in the ap_context config as adAccountId=<id>.

list_campaigns.note: POST /v1/campaigns/query {pagination: {offset, pageSize, fetchTotalCount: true}} in the ad account named by the ap_context config (X-AP-Context header); account_id is not sent and `status` is not applied (filter raw.status: ENABLED / PAUSED). `budget` is the daily budget amount (a decimal string).

get_report.note: POST /v1/reports/apps/campaigns/query {filters: [{field: campaignId, operator: EQUALS, value}], timeRange: {start, end, timeZone: ORTZ}}: App Store campaign totals over the range. Apple requires a campaignId filter on every apps report, so pass campaign_id. Daily granularMetrics are not requested (DAILY needs a start within the last 90 days).

update_budget.note: PUT /v1/campaigns/{id} {dailyBudget: {value: {amount, currency}}} (partial update): changes the daily spend limit of a live campaign. Pass `currency` (the ad account currency).
